title: Multi-Source Lineage Join
description: A record's lineage is assembled by joining the provenance logs of every database that touched it. The join exposes gaps where a database failed to log, which are themselves findings. Teaching ladder: rank 1 — the concept in its simplest, most direct form.
cross_checks: log completeness scan; id continuity check

demo.title: Runnable code demo — Multi-Source Lineage Join
demo.program:
# Cross-database provenance verification: Multi-Source Lineage Join
import hashlib, json
records = [{"source": s.strip(), "payload": "record-body"} for s in "db-audit-log;db-ingest-log;db-export-log".split(";")]
chain = "GENESIS"
for r in records:
    chain = hashlib.sha256((chain + json.dumps(r, sort_keys=True)).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
    print("  linked", r["source"], "->", chain)
print("cross-checks:", "log completeness scan; id continuity check")
print("verdict:", "lineage complete", "- chain intact, provenance verified")
